quant.rule: eligible = status OK on BOTH boards AND pure_selection t >= 2 (full sample) on the basket fair twin AND on the sticky twin (TWIN_STICKY_v1) AND net_minus_market t >= 2 in the validation window (2009-2016, the 'validate' block). The book holds the eligible rules' current picks equally across rules; no eligible rule -> HOLD CASH, by rule, until a re-run board makes one eligible (a new board is read only at the monthly rebalance and its id is recorded on the decision)
